description: [African Arguments] Before dawn, wherever Africa has a coast or a lake, women wait on the shore for the boats. When the catch lands, our work begins. We smoke, dry, salt or ferment the fish, using skills passed down for generations, and carry it to market. We are more than a quarter of the 12.3 million people who work in Africa's fisheries, and 58 percent of its fish processors.
title: Africa: Africa Can't Build a Blue Economy Without the Women Who Bring Its Fish to Market

description: [Daba Finance] South African payments company Yoco has secured a $100 million (1.6 billion rand) credit facility from US investment firm Victory Park Capital Advisors to expand lending to small businesses. The agreement marks Yoco's first direct debt financing arrangement and will allow the company to fund merchant cash advances through its own platform. The facility is intended to help businesses purchase inventory, hire employees, upgrade equipment and open new locations.
title: Africa: South Africa's Yoco Secures $100m for Small Business Lending
